llm.findings:
[SQP-2] expected: The concern is materially privacy-relevant, but the artifacts do disclose reading linked Feishu document content and sending a briefing card; this supports guidance rather than a Review verdict.
[SSD-3] expected: The code forwards meeting title, time, and truncated document previews to FEISHU_MASTER_ID; that is sensitive but purpose-aligned and not hidden, with no evidence of unrelated exfiltration.
llm.guidance: Install only if you intend this agent to read Feishu documents linked from upcoming meetings and send previews to the configured Feishu user or chat. Set FEISHU_MASTER_ID to an authorized recipient, avoid using it on calendars containing confidential documents unless attendees consent, and review output before relying on it for sensitive meetings.
llm.summary: This skill appears to do what it claims: read upcoming Feishu meeting links, fetch linked document previews, and send a briefing card, but it handles sensitive meeting content.
